description: Check out a Git commit of a project and import its assets.

project.description: Git project reference — an OID or a name.

status_checksum.description: Checksum from ``GET /api/v2/projects/{project_id}/status``, sent as the ``x-git-status-checksum`` header; the request fails if it does not match the project's current status.

examples.user_query: Check out the commit 'abc123' from the 'analytics_project' Git repository and ensure the status checksum matches 'def456'.
examples.notes: This call checks out the specified commit from the given Git project and validates the assets for import. Use this when you need to update the project to a specific commit and ensure its integrity.

examples.user_query: How can I switch my 'sales_dashboard' Git project to commit '789xyz' while ensuring the status checksum '123abc' matches?
examples.notes: This call switches the Git project to the specified commit and imports validated assets. Use this when transitioning to a specific commit and ensuring the project status is consistent.

examples.user_query: I need to check out commit '456def' from the 'marketing_insights' Git repository. The current status checksum is '789ghi'.
examples.notes: This call updates the Git project to the specified commit and imports validated assets. Use this when you want to align the project with a particular commit while ensuring the status checksum matches.

description: Create a new Git commit in a project.

project.description: Git project reference — an OID or a name.

message.description: Subject line and optional body of the new commit.

changes.description: File paths whose changes should be included in the commit.

status_checksum.description: Checksum from ``GET /api/v2/projects/{project_id}/status``, sent as the ``x-git-status-checksum`` header; the request fails if it does not match the project's current status.

examples.user_query: Commit all changes in the 'analytics_project' repository with the message 'Update dashboard metrics' and ensure the status checksum matches the current project state.
examples.notes: Creates a new commit in the 'analytics_project' repository, including changes to the specified files, with a descriptive commit message and ensuring the status checksum matches.

examples.user_query: How can I commit changes to the 'sales_data' repository with the message 'Fix data aggregation issue'?
examples.notes: Commits changes to the 'sales_data' repository, addressing a data aggregation issue, with the specified files included in the commit.

examples.user_query: Commit the changes to the 'marketing_campaigns' repository with the message 'Add Q4 campaign details' and include the updated files.
examples.notes: Adds a new commit to the 'marketing_campaigns' repository, including updates for the Q4 campaign details and assets.

description: Retrieve a single Git commit of a project.

project.description: Git project reference — an OID or a name.

examples.user_query: Retrieve the commit with hash 'abc123' from the project 'my-git-project'.
examples.notes: This retrieves details of the specified commit from the given Git project. Use this to inspect a specific commit's metadata and content.

examples.user_query: What are the details of commit 'def456' in the project 'analytics-repo'?
examples.notes: This fetches information about a specific commit in the 'analytics-repo' project. Useful for auditing or debugging changes.

examples.user_query: Get the metadata for commit '789xyz' in the repository 'data-pipeline'.
examples.notes: This retrieves the metadata of a specific commit from the 'data-pipeline' repository. Ideal for tracking changes or reviewing commit history.

description: List all Git commits of a project.

project.description: Git project reference — an OID or a name.

examples.user_query: List all Git commits for the project 'analytics-dashboard'.
examples.notes: Fetches all Git commits for the project named 'analytics-dashboard'. Use this to review the commit history of a specific project.

examples.user_query: What are the commits for the project with ID '12345abc'?
examples.notes: Retrieves the commit history for the project identified by the OID '12345abc'. Useful when working with a project ID instead of a name.

examples.user_query: Show me the Git commit history for the project 'data-pipeline'.
examples.notes: Lists all commits for the project named 'data-pipeline'. Ideal for tracking changes in a specific project repository.
